description: A circular walk around the lovely Ladyburn Lake in Druridge Bay Country Park. There is a mile surfaced path to follow around the large freshwater lake. There are nice views across the water to the park's meadows and woodland. At the northern end of the lake there's also the Ford and Stepping Stones where you can cross from one side to the other. You can continue your walking along the adjacent coastal path and beach on the Druridge Bay to Amble Walk. The park includes good facilities with a car park, visitor information centre and a cafe for some refreshments after your walk.
